title: Kavya Maran to Marry Anirudh Ravichander; Chennai Reception Set for November 21
excerpt: The Telangana Chief Minister's office confirmed the reception after the Maran family delivered the invitation in person. A reported Greece wedding on November 11 remains unconfirmed by the couple.
body:
• Sunrisers Hyderabad CEO Kavya Maran and Jailer 2 composer Anirudh Ravichander are to marry, with a reception in Chennai on November 21 confirmed by the Telangana Chief Minister's office.
  • Kavya's parents, Sun Group chairman Kalanithi Maran and Kavery Maran, personally invited Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy at his Jubilee Hills residence on October 16.
  • Reports in The Times of India and other outlets place the wedding ceremony itself in Greece on November 11; the couple have not confirmed that detail.
  • Anirudh publicly dismissed wedding rumours in 2025, posting "Marriage ah? lol," before family members began hinting the match was real this year.

Kavya Maran, the chief executive of Sunrisers Hyderabad, is to marry composer Anirudh Ravichander. The confirmation came not from the couple but from the Telangana Chief Minister's office, which posted on October 16 that Sun Group chairman Kalanithi Maran and his wife Kavery Maran had visited Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy at his Jubilee Hills residence to invite him to their daughter's wedding reception, Nation Press reported.

The CMO post fixed the one hard date in the story: the reception will be held in Chennai on November 21.

What Is Confirmed, and What Is Reported

A Times of India report, carried by Bollywood Bubble and others, says the wedding ceremony itself will take place in Greece on November 11. That detail has not been confirmed by either family, and neither Anirudh nor Kavya has made a public statement. The reception date, by contrast, comes from an official government account describing a personal invitation.

Who They Are

Kavya Maran is the daughter of Kalanithi Maran, founder of the Sun Group. She runs Sunrisers Hyderabad, the IPL franchise owned by Sun TV Network, where she also serves as an executive director, and she is one of the most visible women in Indian cricket administration, a fixture of IPL auction tables and match-day broadcasts.

Anirudh Ravichander is among the most sought-after composers in Indian cinema, with a run of Tamil and Telugu hits. His latest score, for Rajinikanth's Jailer 2, is in cinemas now during a blockbuster opening run, and his upcoming slate includes Shah Rukh Khan's King, Kamal Haasan's Indian 3 and Rajinikanth's Dharman.

From Denial to Invitations

The couple were first linked in 2025 reports. Anirudh dismissed them at the time, posting on social media, "Marriage ah? lol .. Chill out guys… please stop spreading rumours," Daily Kiran reported. In June this year his uncle, actor Y. Gee Mahendra, publicly congratulated him and called the match "a sure thing," praising Kavya as "not an ordinary girl" with the capacity to run a franchise like Sunrisers.

What's Next

The Chennai reception on November 21 is expected to draw guests from both cricket and cinema, the two industries the marriage joins: the Sun media and IPL empire on one side, and the defining film composer of his generation on the other. Any confirmation of the Greece ceremony date would have to come from the families.
